title: theaphylla viridis
intro: Theaphylla viridis, commonly known as Australian native bush basil, is a plant species native to the eastern coast of Australia. It is a herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Theaphylla viridis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
